title: Candlewick — chapter 1: Tonight, one of the Whale's Bots stopped outside my window
cliffhanger: Tonight, one of the Whale's Bots stopped outside my window. It turned its head.
nextOptions: Ollie goes outside to face the Bot
Ollie hides the phone and runs to Mrs. Pearl
Milo bangs on the door with a new coin idea

scenes.line: In my town, everyone launches memecoins. Everyone.
scenes.setting: the Launch Pad square at noon
scenes.action: a duck presses the big red button, a firework and coins shoot up, Ollie deadpan to camera

scenes.line: The KOLs live on the Hill. Retail lives down here, in the Flats.
scenes.setting: wide view of the Hill's glass towers above the flooded Flats
scenes.action: Ollie on a plank dock looks up at the green chart screens

scenes.line: My best friend Milo launched a coin this morning. It's already at zero.
scenes.action: Milo holds out a cracked phone with a flat red line, Ollie doesn't react

scenes.line: I have a thing I don't talk about. When I look at a chart, the winning trade glows green.
scenes.setting: close on Ollie's face lit by a phone
scenes.action: one candle glows green and reflects in his eye

scenes.line: If the KOLs find out, I'm gone. So I lose on purpose. In public.
scenes.setting: town square under a giant screen with a Caller
scenes.action: Ollie shows a red chart, kids laugh, he shrugs

scenes.line: At night I trade alone. My wallet is bigger than the Whale's. Nobody knows.
scenes.action: Ollie lifts a floorboard, a phone glows green underneath

scenes.line: Tonight, one of the Whale's Bots stopped outside my window. It turned its head.
scenes.action: a grey faceless Bot stands in the rain with its head turned to the window, Ollie frozen by the curtain
